about: Part 2 of the route library: tiny/small fish, specials, bosses, second-Shark co-paths, and laws for them. Same format as fish/*.json. Merge: write each entry of "fish" to fish/<id>.json (or fish/<id>/routes/<route>/ in the new structure), replace shark co_paths, add the three new law sections to laws/laws.json.

anchovy.name: Anchovy
anchovy.role: The sparkle. Fast flashes of silver that make the water feel alive.
anchovy.home: Open water, and the wake behind big fish
anchovy.habit: Flocks of 5-8 that split around obstacles and rejoin. They scatter when a big fish comes within 200 px and re-form 2 s later.
rules: Never more than 2 Anchovy flocks on screen.
Scatter (show only) when a Shark, Marlin or Megalodon is within 200 px.

routes.name: Ribbon
routes.purpose: A long silver wave through the middle band.
rules: Use when the middle band is empty.

routes.name: Bait ball
routes.purpose: Rolls into a tight ball for 3 s, then streams away. A small crowd target.
rules: Not while a Shark lane is within 0.2 of the ball spot.
Best right before a Marlin slash (gives it something to cut through).

routes.name: Split and rejoin
routes.purpose: Splits into two halves that go around the middle and meet again.
rules: Used when a Turtle or Puffer sits in the middle.

routes.name: Wake rider
routes.purpose: Follows 2 s behind a Marlin or Shark through its wake.
rules: Only after a fast big fish; keeps 2 s behind it, never ahead.

clownfish.name: Clownfish
clownfish.role: The friendly one. Stays close to a seat so beginners get easy, steady catches.
clownfish.home: Right in front of the seats (one "home spot" per seat)
clownfish.habit: Small groups of 3-6 that dart out from a seat and back. Slow, short trips.
rules: Visits are shared out by the seat fairness memory, so every seat gets its turn.
A seat with a dry spell over 30 s gets the next Clownfish visit (show only, odds unchanged).

routes.name: Seat home
routes.purpose: Swims to one seat, hangs there 3 s, and goes back the way it came.
rules: Target seat = the seat with the least tiny-fish time lately.

routes.name: Hop along
routes.purpose: Hops along one seat row, a short stop at each seat.
rules: Alternate rows: top row, then bottom row next time.

routes.name: Peek
routes.purpose: Pops up from a seat edge, looks around, and dives back.
rules: Never under a Hammerhead rail patrol on the same row.

butterflyfish.name: Butterflyfish
butterflyfish.role: Color and calm. Gentle movers that fill the quiet parts of a wave.
butterflyfish.habit: Travel in pairs inside a group of 3-6, fluttering up and down as they go.
rules: Used most in calm scenes; fewer during hunts.

routes.name: Pair flutter
routes.purpose: A slow flutter across the upper middle.

routes.name: Loop-de-loop
routes.purpose: One loop in the middle, then on its way.
rules: No loop while the Manta is within 0.25.

routes.name: Drift down
routes.purpose: Floats down from the top seats to the bottom seats.
rules: Pick a top seat with little traffic as the start.

minnow.name: Minnow
minnow.role: The Sardine's rival in the see-saw. Quick and twitchy, good for fast shooters.
minnow.home: Wherever the Sardines are not (the see-saw decides)
minnow.habit: Schools of 3-6 that zigzag with sharp turns and sudden stops.
rules: See-saw: when Sardines are up, Minnows are down, and the other way round (already in game).

routes.name: Zigzag
routes.purpose: Sharp zigzag across the screen.

routes.name: Dart and stop
routes.purpose: Darts in, freezes for a second, then bolts.

routes.name: Switchback
routes.purpose: Almost crosses, then turns back the way it came.
rules: Never toward a Shark lane.

pufferfish.name: Pufferfish
pufferfish.role: The easy, funny target. Slow and round; puffs up when hit a lot.
pufferfish.home: Low middle, close to the bottom seats
pufferfish.habit: Alone or 2-3. Bobs slowly. After 6 hits in 3 s it puffs up for 2 s and slows down (show only).

reactions.name: Puff
reactions.effect: puffs up and slows for 2 s

rules: Puff never changes catch chance or pay.

routes.name: Bob
routes.purpose: A slow bobbing pass along the low middle.

routes.name: Rise
routes.purpose: Comes up from the bottom seats, turns, and sinks back.
rules: Mirror to the top half every other time so top seats get it too.

routes.name: Linger
routes.purpose: Stops in the middle for 4 s, an easy shared target.
rules: Not while a Shark is on screen.

lionfish.name: Lionfish
lionfish.role: The escort. Rides with big fish so the big moments have small catches around them.
lionfish.home: Beside big fish, or along the side edges
lionfish.habit: 40% of big fish come with 2-3 Lionfish escorts (in game). Alone, it hovers and fans its fins.
rules: Escorts leave with their big fish.
Never escort the Shark during a Manta meeting (too crowded).

routes.name: Escort ring
routes.purpose: Circles around a big fish while it travels (in game).

routes.name: Fan hover
routes.purpose: Drifts slowly with two stops to fan its fins.

routes.name: Edge cruise
routes.purpose: Slides down a side edge, past the corner seats.
rules: Left and right edges take turns.

seahorse.name: Seahorse
seahorse.role: The little treat. Slow, rare and worth a bit more.
seahorse.home: Seat corners; moves up and down rather than across
seahorse.habit: Alone or a pair. Very slow, upright, bobbing.
rules: At most 1 Seahorse visit per seat corner every 2 minutes.

routes.name: Climb
routes.purpose: Climbs slowly from the bottom seats to the top seats.
rules: Pick the seat column with the least small-fish time.

routes.name: Corner bob
routes.purpose: Comes out of a corner, bobs up and down, goes back.

routes.name: Pair dance
routes.purpose: Two Seahorses, one from the top and one from the bottom, meet near the middle and go home.
rules: Only when the middle is clear of big fish.

bombcrab.name: Bomb Crab
bombcrab.role: The crowd clearer. Catching it blows up fish nearby (150 px) for a big shared moment.
bombcrab.home: The seabed: the seat rows along the top and bottom edges
bombcrab.habit: Walks sideways along a seat row. The director sends it when a crowd has gathered.
rules: Only when at least 8 fish are within its blast radius somewhere on its path.
Max 1 on screen; at least 40 s between crabs.
Not during a boss scene.
Not within 10 s of a Lightning Eel.

routes.name: Seabed walk
routes.purpose: Walks the full bottom row, past every bottom seat.
rules: Rows take turns: bottom, then top.

routes.name: Into the crowd
routes.purpose: Walks toward the busiest spot, waits there 3 s, and walks back.
rules: Target = densest fish spot within 0.35 of a seat row.

routes.name: Ceiling walk
routes.purpose: Walks the top row upside down.

eel.name: Lightning Eel
eel.role: The spark. Catching it chains to 6 nearby fish, the big excitement spike.
eel.habit: Swims in an S, fast, alone. Glows brighter the more fish are near it.
rules: Max 1 on screen; at least 45 s between eels.
Route must pass at least 10 fish so the chain has targets.
Not during a boss scene.

routes.name: Long S
routes.purpose: An S-wave right through the middle.

routes.name: Through the school
routes.purpose: Follows the path of the biggest Sardine school so the chain hits.
rules: Only when a school of 6+ is on screen.

routes.name: Edge snap
routes.purpose: Runs the top row, snaps down through the middle, leaves along the bottom row.

healer.name: Healer Jellyfish
healer.role: The gentle boss. Slow and glowing; a calm, team-up fight.
healer.home: Center; rises from the bottom, sinks back at the end
healer.habit: Pulses: rises, holds, rises again. Trails baby jellies (small, low pay).
rules: Bosses own the stage: no big fish, the big-fish clock waits.
Mediums only as escorts; small fish keep 0.15 away from the boss.
The boss spends equal time near top, bottom, left and right seats.
It never leaves before the scene ends (minus 4 s).
phases: Lantern drift past each seat column

routes.name: Bloom
routes.purpose: Rises, draws a slow figure-8 in the middle, and sinks.

routes.name: Lantern drift
routes.purpose: Drifts side to side, stopping at each seat column.

megalodon.name: Megalodon
megalodon.role: The big show. Huge, fast for its size, always moving.
megalodon.habit: Never stops. Passes close to every seat row once per lap. Small fish scatter in front of it.
rules: Bosses own the stage: no big fish, the big-fish clock waits.
Mediums only as escorts; small fish keep 0.15 away from the boss.
The boss spends equal time near top, bottom, left and right seats.
It never leaves before the scene ends (minus 4 s).
Charges come with a 1 s warning shadow.

routes.name: Laps
routes.purpose: Two wide laps past every seat, then out.

routes.name: Charges
routes.purpose: Three straight passes: top, middle, bottom. Turns off screen.
rules: Order of rows is random each time.

routes.name: Circling
routes.purpose: Circles in, getting tighter, then breaks out.

giantsquid.name: Giant Squid
giantsquid.role: The reacher. Tentacles stretch toward the seats.
giantsquid.home: Center, reaching out to both seat rows
giantsquid.habit: Swims backwards in jets; holds still to reach. Squirts ink when hit hard (show only).

reactions.name: Ink
reactions.effect: ink cloud and a jet away

rules: Bosses own the stage: no big fish, the big-fish clock waits.
Mediums only as escorts; small fish keep 0.15 away from the boss.
The boss spends equal time near top, bottom, left and right seats.
It never leaves before the scene ends (minus 4 s).

routes.name: Seat reach
routes.purpose: Holds in the middle, leans toward the top seats, then the bottom seats.

routes.name: Jet
routes.purpose: Moves in short, fast jets with pauses between.

kraken.name: Kraken
kraken.role: The finale. The rarest boss. Rises from the deep and holds the stage.
kraken.habit: Barely moves; its tentacles sweep the seat rows instead.
rules: Bosses own the stage: no big fish, the big-fish clock waits.
Mediums only as escorts; small fish keep 0.15 away from the boss.
The boss spends equal time near top, bottom, left and right seats.
It never leaves before the scene ends (minus 4 s).
Rarest boss: at most once per night.

routes.name: Rise and hold
routes.purpose: Rises up the middle and holds there a long time, then sinks.
rules: Tentacles sweep top row, then bottom row, during the hold.

routes.name: Slow sweep
routes.purpose: Drifts across the lower half, very slowly.

routes.name: Dive and resurface
routes.purpose: Rises on the left, dives, and comes back up on the right.

shark_co_paths.name: Shadow
shark_co_paths.effect: A smaller second Shark follows 2-3 s behind in the same lane.

shark_co_paths.name: Pincer
shark_co_paths.effect: A smaller second Shark takes the mirrored lane at the same moment, never touching.

shark_co_paths.name: Hunting pair
shark_co_paths.effect: Two Sharks swim the same route 1.5 s apart side by side, offset 0.12; only on Cruise or Patrol.

shark_co_paths.name: Size-up
shark_co_paths.effect: Two Sharks enter from opposite edges, stop 0.3 apart for 2 s facing each other, then the smaller one turns away.

shark_co_paths.name: Food fight
shark_co_paths.effect: Two Sharks dive at the same Sardine school from opposite sides; both leave as soon as it scatters.

shark_co_paths.name: Standoff
shark_co_paths.effect: One Shark holds a lane at the middle for 3 s while the other waits off screen; then they swap.

shark_co_paths.name: Waiting holder
shark_co_paths.effect: If the second Shark cannot get a lane, it circles just off screen (a fin shows at the edge) until the lane opens.

shark_co_paths.name: Frenzy spreads
shark_co_paths.effect: If one Shark goes into Frenzy, the second one speeds up 20% for 3 s (show only).

small_fish.what: Never more than 2 Anchovy flocks on screen.
Tiny fish scatter when a fast big fish comes this close (show only).
A seat dry this long gets the next Clownfish visit. Show only, odds unchanged.
small_fish.try_next: Try 20 s for a beginner-heavy table.

small_fish.what: Gap between Seahorse visits to the same seat corner.
Hits that make a Pufferfish puff up (show only).
Chance a big fish brings 2-3 Lionfish escorts (in game v5).

specials.what: A Bomb Crab is only sent when this many fish could be in its blast.
The Eel route must pass this many fish so the chain has targets.
A Crab and an Eel never come within this many seconds of each other.

bosses.what: No big fish during a boss; the big-fish clock waits.
Small fish keep this far from a boss (screen fraction).
A boss spends equal time near top, bottom, left and right seats.
The Kraken comes at most once per night.
Megalodon charges show a shadow this long before.
